purpose: Freeze the plan's initial same-pool score grid before choosing weights on tuning artwork
generation_policy: Reference targets and feature annotations are available only to benchmark selection diagnosis, never to generation

corpus.sword_policy: Development comparison only; do not select calibration weights from the sword
corpus.heldout_policy: Excluded from calibration; reserve fresh artwork families and degradations for release evaluation
corpus.coverage_status: Current plumbing fixtures are below the plan's release collection target

objective.visual: color * terms.color + alpha * terms.alpha + edges * terms.edges + features * terms.features
objective.normalizer_policy: Use each audited source pool's positive fixed normalizer for every configuration and complexity
objective.hard_gate_policy: Exclude hard-invalid candidates before replay; score weights never alter hard validation

selection_diagnosis.scope: Replay the same exactly evaluated candidate pool before any generation rerun
selection_diagnosis.oracle_policy: Report the clean-target oracle under the selected candidate's cost ceiling separately from production-score selection
selection_diagnosis.candidate_coverage_policy: When faithful compact alternatives are absent, report missing coverage rather than declaring new weights a solution
selection_diagnosis.aggregation_policy: Require per-artwork feature, hole, coverage and line gates before aggregate quality and representation savings
selection_diagnosis.line_gate: Initial maximum clean-vector line F1 drop is one percentage point from the frozen baseline
selection_diagnosis.per_case_feature_coverage_gates: Must be versioned from the baseline before choosing finalists; remain pending where absent

generation_reruns.effort_policy: Use identical deterministic evaluation caps and matched deadlines; record changed proposal availability separately from same-pool score ordering

deferred_grids: Declare three geometric-regularization weights after the evaluator computes a normalized geometric term
